perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: No materially newer source displaced FQ1 2027: $1.485B sales, 38% year-over-year growth, lower inventory days, margin recovery, book-to-bill above 1 and PCIe Gen6 design-win momentum remain the reusable signals.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Recovery evidence is visible, but a depressed comparison base and design-win-to-production lag prevent treating one quarter as proof of normalized cycle strength.

contradictions: Strong year-over-year growth follows a depressed base and may overstate normalized demand strength.

lineage.searchStrategy: defensible cumulative evidence reuse; no repeated low-value search after freshness check found no material displacement
